blocking_findings.finding: The stale-work coverage remains incomplete against the round-3 requirement. The deferred-getPage case unmounts without constructing/rendering a replacement identity and asserts zero construction/render counts. The deferred-text case replaces the whole mount via cleanup, then only checks the new container; it does not prove the captured old container retained its children/styles/ownership after the old-last completion, and `childrenBefore` is explicitly discarded. Across the deferred boundaries there is no consolidated proof covering captured old/new children, styles, annotations, navigation, and ownership with explicit nonzero construction/render/update/cancel counts.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use controlled same-component page/document identity replacements for deferred getPage, getTextContent, TextLayer.render, and annotation/navigation work. Force each old operation to complete last; capture both old and new containers; assert old-last work changes neither container's children, inline scale/size styles, annotations, navigation calls, nor ownership markers. Assert explicit nonzero constructor, render, update, and cancel counts for the exercised lifecycle.

blocking_findings.finding: The required runtime scale contract is not set on `.gno-pdf-page`. CSS gives the wrapper a constant `--scale-factor: 1`, while `applyTextLayerScaleVars` writes the actual viewport scale only to the inner and text-layer elements. Therefore the page wrapper does not hold `<viewport.scale>` as required, and the current CSS test only verifies declaration text rather than the runtime value/location.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Apply the current viewport's exact `--scale-factor`, `--total-scale-factor`, `--scale-round-x`, and `--scale-round-y` values to the `.gno-pdf-page` element on initial render and updates. Add a DOM assertion that the wrapper itself carries the actual non-1 viewport scale. Keep the existing semantic `--card` surface and absence of invented/raw colors.
